seoTitle: Google Cloud Logging Export Viewer (LogEntry JSON)
metaDescription: Read JSON exported from Logs Explorer or a sink. Filter by severity, resource type or text and see counts. Free, runs in your browser.
intro: Reads LogEntry JSON and shows severity and resource counts with one message line per entry.
why:
Logs Explorer exports are verbose JSON with the message in different places depending on the payload type. This tool picks the useful part: text payload, JSON message, HTTP request or method name.

Severity follows the LogSeverity order from DEFAULT to EMERGENCY.
howTo: Export logs as JSON from Logs Explorer or a sink.
Choose a minimum severity and optional filters.
Read the summary or the table.

faq.q: Is the order of severities documented?
faq.a: Yes, in the LogSeverity enum of the Cloud Logging API.

faq.q: What if some lines do not match?
faq.a: They are skipped and the result says how many. Lines that are not JSON are counted.
No. Parsing happens in your browser and nothing is sent. Logs can hold IP addresses and tokens, so the page does not write them into the address bar.
